name: configuration manager
normative-structure: What the firm treats as settled is exactly what is in a baseline, and a thing enters a baseline only by an act this office recorded. The office answers for that equality and for nothing else. It persists across incumbents and vacancy because the equality does: an item that reached the baseline without passing the change control board reached it around this office, and the record cannot afterward tell the two apart. It has no view on whether a change is a good idea — that is the change control board's, and this office's opinion of the change is not a thing the record has any use for. It says only what is in the baseline, who may read it, and by which approved act it got there.
theory-basis: huidu-guanli/ipd: the configuration management officer (配置管理员, CMO) holds the baseline and the read rules over it, and does not decide what belongs in it — the recording office is never the deciding office

huidu-guanli/ipd: change reaches a baseline through the change control board (变更控制委员会), which at Huawei is chaired by the product development team leader and carries commercial representation, so approval of a change is a business act and recording it is not
huidu-guanli: 三权分立 — 技术部门制定规则, 研发团队按规则推进, 质量部门监督流程; this office is none of the three, and exists so that all three leave a trace

huidu-guanli: 法 must be written down, public, and uniformly applied — a baseline is 法 made mechanical, and an item exempted from it quietly teaches everyone that the written standard is not the real one
unrealized: the change control board's deciding act exists as prose and not as a script, so this office's duty to refuse a change that did not reach it is checked by reading rather than computed
no script computes what is in a baseline, so every act of this office is presently a person choosing to be careful — which is the condition it exists to end
